data.name: Kia Carnival Long-Term Hire
data.description: Long-term Kia Carnival hire across Melbourne. A comfortable 8-seater with sliding rear doors, made for families, sports teams, staff transport and group trips.

mainEntity.name: How much does the Kia Carnival cost to hire?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Kia Carnival is $250 per week including GST, with 1,400 km included each week and a $500 bond.

mainEntity.name: How many people does it seat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Carnival seats 8 including the driver, with luggage space behind the third row.
Yes, the Carnival is an automatic and easy to drive, even fully loaded.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire it long-term for a family or team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It suits families, sports clubs and businesses on flexible weekly and monthly terms, with no long lock-in contract.
